lines.zh: 我抱着记录本，走在院子里
lines.en: Notebook in hand, I cross the yard.

lines.zh: 我停下来在本子上画两笔
lines.en: I stop and sketch a few lines.
Mud on my boots; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我在房子和围栏之间来回
lines.en: I pace between the house and the pens.
I glance into the pens as I walk.

lines.zh: 我数了一遍围栏的数量
lines.en: I count the number of fences.

lines.zh: 我的口袋里塞着各种样本
lines.en: My pockets are stuffed with samples.

lines.zh: 我绕到屋后去看新的窝
lines.en: I go behind the house to check the new nests.
My steps are light, so as not to startle them.
I pause by the bench.
I tuck the pen behind my ear.
I walk slowly along the path.
I am looking for yesterday's notes.
I look up at the birds under the eaves.
I sit at the desk, turning pages.
I chew the pen and think.
The one in the cage is watching me.
I am counting its legs.
This page has been soaked.
I have hung up my hat.
Sun falls on my desk.
I write today's date.
Something calls outside.
I push my glasses up.
There is straw on my cuff.
I get up to pour water.
I stare at the specimen in the jar.
The room is quiet. Good.
I look up, my pen still on the page.
Do not go yet; I have questions.
Hold still; let me look at you.
There is something particular about you.

lines.zh: 我对活的东西很感兴趣
lines.en: I am very interested in living things.
Do you mind if I note this down?
You have calluses on your hands.
You come from outside.
Everyone around here has been recorded.

lines.zh: 我写东西的时候不喜欢被打断
lines.en: I dislike interruption while writing.
You may sit and talk.
I close the notebook.
You are not a local species.
I am observing your breathing.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有另一种泥
lines.en: That mud on your boots is different.

lines.zh: 把手臂伸出来，我量一量。
lines.en: Hold out your arm; let me measure.
I press the place I was struck.
One arm of my glasses is off.
I steady myself on the desk.
That interrupted my writing.
Half a step back; I did not drop the pen.
The hand I write with is shaking.
That is not important; I can still stand.
I wipe my mouth on my sleeve.
Blood stains the notebook.
I will have to rewrite a page.
I do not put that in my mouth.
My meals are at fixed times.
Specimens matter more than food.
Put it on the desk.
I eat and take notes together.
This is my second meal today.
It has gone a little cold. Fine.
Thanks, but I must finish this page.
You eat half.
Keep it; I have no use for it.
Sorry, I was not watching the path.

lines.zh: 铅笔滚到桌子底下去了。
lines.en: My pencil rolled under the desk.
I step back and adjust my glasses.

lines.zh: 你撞到我手里的样本瓶
lines.en: You bumped the sample jar in my hand.
We both stop short.
My notes scatter on the ground.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去把它们捡起来
lines.en: I crouch to gather them.
That mixed up the labels.
Do not step there; those are records.
I am fine; do not worry.

lines.zh: 我的时间都花在记录上
lines.en: My time goes into records.

lines.zh: 这件事我研究过，但没实践
lines.en: I have studied this, but not practiced it.
I must finish this volume first.
There is only me and the specimens.

lines.zh: 你这话让我不知怎么记
lines.en: I would not know how to note that down.
I prefer quiet subjects.
Let us talk of something else.
I do not understand people well either.
I push my glasses up and say nothing.
That falls outside my records.
I bend and pick up the sample.
This can serve as a label.
This tuft is enough for a page of sketches.
This is not mine.
I check the number on it.
This leaf still needs a number.
This is somewhat interesting.

lines.zh: 我得先画下来再收起来
lines.en: Let me sketch it before storing it.
It has already dried.
I leave it on the sill to dry.
Do not go yet; I need to take notes.
I turn the notebook to a blank page.
I do not yet know your habits.
I have been observing you a while.
I will need to make a mark.
You keep moving; I cannot draw accurately.
This point matters.
Do not be afraid; I am only looking.
I have written it down.
I must verify once more.
I have two pages on your stride.
I have made marks in my notebook.

lines.zh: 我在等一个自然的姿势
lines.en: I am waiting for a natural pose.
This page is nearly full.
Do not hide; I will not hurt you.
I only want to confirm.

lines.zh: 你在紧张，这也在记录里
lines.en: You are tense; that too goes in the record.
This data is hard to collect.
Give me a little longer.
Hold still. Just like that.
I raise the notebook to block.
I have only a pen in hand.
That was very unprofessional.

lines.zh: 我抓了一只笼子挡在身前
lines.en: I hold a cage up in front of me.
My specimen jar broke.

lines.zh: 我抡起捕虫网朝你头上砸。
lines.en: I swing my bug net at your head.
I pinch you with the calipers.
I did not mean that.
I straighten my glasses and keep writing.
The records are all disordered.
I am just coming out of the house.
I still have a pen in hand.
The cages in the yard are all empty.
I meant to do some observation today.
I spread the notebook on the sill.

lines.zh: 这附近的动物我都认识
lines.en: I know every animal around here.
First I note the time and place.
There are unfamiliar prints outside.
I push the door open and look out.
I set my hat straight.
My cuff catches fire.
The notebook flies first; then I fall.

lines.zh: 水进了我的鼻子和嘴里
lines.en: Water goes up my nose and mouth.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的书都掀飞了
lines.en: The blast throws my books everywhere.

lines.zh: 一支箭贴着我的肩过去
lines.en: An arrow skims my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的手指发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my fingers.
Too hungry to write.

lines.zh: 雷声让我手一抖，笔掉了
lines.en: Thunder shocks my hand; the pen falls.
There is nowhere to stand here.
